### Cato Labs // Intake & Interactive Client Intelligence

An intake and discovery environment built with editorial restraint, tactile obsidian surfaces, and kinetic depth. Driven by real-time voice, vision, and cognitive agent orchestration, this system streamlines high-touch onboarding into an uninterrupted client experience.

#### Technical Directives & System Architecture

* **Modular Architecture (Zero Monoliths):** Strictly decouple components into isolated, purpose-built modules. Split UI views, state slices, WebGL canvas renderers, and API orchestrators into distinct, dedicated units (`/components`, `/hooks`, `/services/gemini`, `/services/agent-api`).
* **Live Multimodal Protocol:** Target `gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking` for bidirectional voice/vision streaming to leverage background reasoning without conversational latency penalties.
* **Dynamic Model Resolution:** Ensure `list_models` executes a fresh query against the API with client-side caching bypassed (`GET /v1beta/models`), guaranteeing newly served release models are immediately selectable and visible in the client context.
* **Agent API & OpenAPI Strictness:** Full compliance with the official OpenAPI schema for the Agent API. Every schema capability—including tool definitions, structured function calls, state handoffs, and payload validations—must be enabled, strictly typed, and cleanly abstracted. All models must be set to their max token output (128k for all but gemini which is 65k) YOu must set max_token_output for Anthropic models, and all agents must be equipped with all tools and teh AGent API must be implemented per the open api schema with alll features enabled. 
* **Visual Direction & Tactile Minimalism:** Monolithic typography (Geist / Inter Display) set over deep obsidian backgrounds (`#08080A`), accented with high-precision specular top rims (`shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.12)]`), muted hairline borders, and hardware-accelerated interactive surfaces.
